paper_metadata.title: Portfolio Optimization Based on Quantum HHL Algorithm

summary: The paper formulates a 3-asset portfolio optimization problem as a quadratic program with equality constraints and converts it to a linear system solved by HHL. Using a 9-qubit Qiskit circuit with 2 phase-estimation bits and 0.9 success probability, the paper reports an approximate portfolio weight ratio of 3:5:12, normalized to (0.1608, 0.2557, 0.5833), versus the exact solution (0.16216216, 0.25675676, 0.58108108).

experiments.description: Portfolio optimization formulated as a quadratic programming problem with equality constraints and solved using the HHL quantum linear-systems algorithm on IBM's quantum computing platform via Qiskit.

algorithm.variant: HHL for portfolio optimization / quadratic programming with equality constraints

problem_formulation.encoding_details: The quadratic program is converted to a linear system A|x>=|b>; the 3-asset portfolio vector is embedded by expanding b to 8 dimensions so that 3 qubits represent |b>, and A is expanded to 8x8.
problem_formulation.objective_function: min_w w^T Σ w subject to μ^T w = μ0 and P^T w = ξ
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Equality constraints handled via Lagrange multipliers, converting the constrained quadratic program into a linear system for HHL; no penalty formulation reported.

problem_instance.description: Synthetic 3-asset portfolio optimization example with specified mean returns and asset correlation matrix.
problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Problem is manually constructed; b is padded with zeros to 8 dimensions and A is expanded to 8x8 to fit the quantum register size.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Single worked example; approximate solution compared with exact solution by component ratios and normalized vector.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Construct linear system from portfolio optimization model; pad vectors/matrices to 8 dimensions; build HHL circuit with Qiskit.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Measure ancilla qubit; when ancilla=1 and phase-estimation register is 0, extract amplitudes for |010>, |011>, |100>; normalize to obtain portfolio weights.
